levels.description: Gain Inner Ki: start each combat with Ki equal to 10% of your character level, rounded down (minimum 1).

effects.name: Inner Ki
effects.description: At combat start, gain Ki equal to floor(10% of character level), minimum 1. Ki lasts only for this combat.

levels.description: Unlock Ki Focus: spend 1 Ki to increase the power of your next attack or spell by 20%. No cooldown.

effects.name: Ki Focus
effects.description: Spend 1 Ki to increase the power of your next attack or spell by 20%. The charge is consumed even if the attack misses. No cooldown or AP cost.

levels.description: Unlock Ki Infusion: spend 2 Ki to restore 40% maximum Mana plus 0.5× Mind. Once per combat.

effects.name: Ki Infusion
effects.description: Spend 2 Ki to restore 40% maximum Mana plus 0.5× Mind. Once per combat; no AP cost.

levels.description: Gain Flow of Ki: restore 1 Ki at the start of every second personal turn, up to capacity.

effects.name: Flow of Ki
effects.description: Restore 1 Ki at the start of every second personal combat turn, up to capacity.

levels.description: Unlock Ki Overdrive: spend 3 Ki to deal 45% more damage with attacks and spells for two personal turns.

effects.name: Ki Overdrive
effects.description: Spend 3 Ki. Attacks and spells deal 45% more damage for two personal turns. Once per combat; no AP cost.
